Manoj Kumar & Ors vs The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr on 13
August, 2024
 $~16
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
+ Crl.M.C. 4262/2024
 Manoj Kumar & Ors. 
 Th

ve
 The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr 
 Through: Mr. Hitesh Vali, 
 with Mr. Deepanka
 with Si Manisha S
 Garhi.

Mr. Ekram Ali Ans
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal

1.  This petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.53/2021 PS Maidan Garhi under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC basis of settlement dated 31st, August, 2023, arrived at with the facilitation of Counselling Cell, Family Court, Saket, New Delhi, which is on record of this Court.

entities.text: Counselling Cell, Family Court, Saket, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Petitioner Nos.1-7 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court (except for petitioner No.6 who is exempted) and duly identified by the IO and their respective counsels.
3. As per the settlement, an outstanding balance of Rs.20,000/- is tendered vide DD No.427626 drawn on Kotak Mahindra Bank and duly received by respondent No.2 in Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 15/08/2024 at 04:06:00 4.

The marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was solemnised on 23rd January, 2014,
but due to marital discord, the marriage has resulted in a divorce by decree dated 20th November,
2023.
No child was born out of wedlock.

5. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State Manoj Kumar & Ors vs The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/96533674/
1 exchequer.

entities.text: State Manoj Kumar & Ors vs The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.53/2021 PS Maidan Garhi under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
6. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
7. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
8. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J AUGUST 13, 2024/MK
